test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

You can do your work well within the stipulated time and be more productive if you learn to keep video games __at the length of your arm.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **at arm’s length**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"at arm’s length"** means to keep something at a distance, both physically and metaphorically. (एक हाथ की दूरी पर)
